text.tspan: 把外部 Agent 变成“本地只读复盘大脑”的协作图 / Turning external agents into a local read-only review brain
Compatible external tools / 可兼容的外部工具
Logos are trademarks of their respective owners and are used only to indicate compatibility.
External Agents -> Harness: read AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md / harness contract
Harness -> External Agents: artifacts for review / 复盘产物回传
Local Notes & Screenshots / 本地笔记与截图
External Research Reports / 外部研究报告
Toy Offline Fixtures / toy 离线样例
• no private data / 不含私有数据
Local External Review Brain · No embedded LLM API · Read-only
本地外置复盘大脑 · 无内置 LLM API · 只读
• toy or local data / toy 或本地数据
人工复核 / 规则治理
• owns final judgment / 保留最终判断
manual approval only / 仅人工批准
blocked by design / 设计上禁止
External agents may reason, review, and challenge. They must not execute trades.
外部 Agent 可以推理、复盘、质疑，但不能执行交易。
No broker connector / 不接券商
No account automation / 不做账户自动化
